tagline: Cost, budget, and anomaly analysis for remote teammates — every Cost Explorer query bills about a cent.
requirements: Configure AWS credentials on the host (a profile via AWS_PROFILE or the standard credential chain) with read-only Billing and Cost Management permissions such as ce:GetCostAndUsage. This is the official AWS Labs server; Cost Explorer API calls cost roughly $0.01 each.

tools.name: status
tools.note: Reports the configured identity and billing views.

tools.name: cost-explorer
tools.note: Cost and usage queries grouped by service, region, or tags (action-based).

tools.name: cost-comparison
tools.note: Compares spend between two periods and lists the top change drivers.

tools.name: cost-anomaly
tools.note: Lists cost anomalies and their root causes.

tools.name: budget
tools.note: Reads budgets and their status against actual spend.

tools.name: storage-lens
tools.note: S3 storage metrics and cost breakdowns (action-based).

tools.name: compute-optimizer
tools.note: Right-sizing recommendations for EC2, Lambda, and EBS.

tools.name: session-sql
tools.note: Runs SQL over data fetched earlier in the same session.

seo.description: Share the official AWS Billing MCP server with MCPWire. Configure read-only credentials on the host, let teammates analyze spend, budgets, and anomalies over P2P, and keep the toolset read-only.
